title: The pope urges the faithful on Christmas to shed indifference in the face of suffering
summary: During his first Christmas Day message, Pope Leo XIV highlighted the suffering in Gaza, Yemen and among migrants, and called for peace in troubled regions like Lebanon, Ukraine and Syria.

title: Highway in B.C. reopens after atmospheric rivers washed out sections
summary: A portion of a British Columbia highway linking the Lower Mainland to Alberta that’s been closed since atmospheric rivers washed away sections of the road earlier this month has reopened.
